+import pytest
+
+import sqlparse
+from sqlparse.exceptions import SQLParseError
+
+
+def test_custom_assignment_names():
+    source = 'select 1; select 2'
+    assert sqlparse.format(
+        source, output_format='python', output_varname='query'
+    ) == "query = 'select 1; '\nquery2 = 'select 2'"
+    assert sqlparse.format(
+        source, output_format='php', output_varname='query'
+    ) == '$query = "select 1; ";\n$query2 = "select 2";'
+
+
+def test_multiline_custom_assignment():
+    assert sqlparse.format(
+        'select * from foo;', output_format='python',
+        output_varname='q_7', reindent=True
+    ) == "q_7 = ('select * '\n       'from foo;')"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('name', ['', '2q', 'q-x', '$q', 'q x', 'é', None, 4, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('output_format', ['python', 'php', 'sql', None])
+def test_reject_invalid_assignment_name(name, output_format):
+    with pytest.raises(SQLParseError):
+        sqlparse.format('select 1', output_format=output_format, output_varname=name)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('output_format', ['sql', None])
+def test_no_assignment_in_sql_output(output_format):
+    assert sqlparse.format(
+        'select 1;', output_format=output_format, output_varname='query'
+    ) == 'select 1;'
+
+
+def test_default_assignment_name_is_unchanged():
+    assert sqlparse.format('select 1', output_format='python') == "sql = 'select 1'"
+    assert sqlparse.format('select 1', output_format='php') == '$sql = "select 1";'

spec.question: Add an output_varname option to sqlparse.format for generated Python and PHP assignments. When omitted, keep the existing sql, sql2, and subsequent names. When supplied, it must be a string matching the ASCII form [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; reject every other value with SQLParseError, even when output_format is 'sql' or omitted. For Python, use the supplied name directly; for PHP, add the existing dollar-sign prefix. Number later statements by appending 2, 3, and so on, and use the custom name when calculating continuation-line indentation. A valid output_varname must have no effect on ordinary SQL output. Deliver a unified diff against production files only; leave tests unchanged.
